title: Port plugin busy registration, identity cleanup and live first-busy lookup
scope: Complete registerBusy/pluginBusy and associated ordered check/store/stop metadata; preserve exact check identity, duplicate IDs, live mutation and suppressed check errors. Stop invocation belongs to a separate unit.
acceptance: Pinned complete activity source runs independent identity/order/mutation inputs first; compare full map states, returned messages, cleanup and callback effects.
Old cleanup matches function identity, not registration generation; delete/re-add is visited live and bounded resource refusals stay separate.
open_items: Implement and compare the complete scoped bodies; asynchronous stop invocation and engine integration remain separate.
